role: Write the user-facing launch guide for the Townfall mod launch: what the console owner does, sees, and what success/failure looks like.

scope.deliverable: USER-LAUNCH-GUIDE.md (one-page, non-technical guide for the console owner)

sources_read: outputs/2026-10-04-zcode-team/worker-post-promotion-runtime/RUNTIME-STAGING-PLAN.md (launch sequence section 5, expected evidence section 6, directory layout section 2)
outputs/2026-10-04-zcode-team/worker-acceptance-evidence/EVIDENCE-SPEC.md (shared evidence channels, launch ritual 0.2, rung 4 mod load line, rung 5 pad mapping OPTIONS=F7)
outputs/2026-10-04-zcode-team/worker-itemspawner-bundle/FIRST-RUN-CHECKLIST.md (phase 1 load line byte-exact, phase 2 no-save behavior, failure discrimination)
outputs/2026-10-04-zcode-team/worker-console-safety/CONSOLE-SAFETY-PROCEDURE.md (launch ritual, no blind relaunch, crash recovery, user-controlled power/restart)
claims: The guide is a faithful non-technical translation of the four source documents only; it adds no new technical claims and asserts nothing has already run on the console.

User-visible launch flow per RUNTIME-STAGING-PLAN section 5: game fully closed, controller stages and verifies everything first, ploader armed, USER launches Townfall (never automated), injection reported ~1 minute in, one launch per staged build.

Success marker per FIRST-RUN-CHECKLIST phase 1: exactly one log line '[TownfallItemSpawner] Loaded v1.0. Clean pickup-only release. F7 opens the menu.' in the active retained log (collected by the controller, not looked for by the user), plus the menu opening on OPTIONS (=F7 per the pad mapping in EVIDENCE-SPEC rung 5).

Expected non-fault behavior included: without a save loaded the menu may not appear and nothing shows on screen while the log records 'Item database not ready. Load a save first.' — this matches FIRST-RUN-CHECKLIST phase 2 and is presented as expected, not as failure.

Failure handling per CONSOLE-SAFETY-PROCEDURE: on failure close the game, record what was seen, tell the controller, no repeated relaunches or blind retries; console power/restart is user-controlled and reported back before anything else is attempted.
